name: browser-use
headline: ShareAI Skills - Extend AI Agent Capabilities
short_description: ShareAI Skills are knowledge packages that extend AI agent capabilities. They enable agents to build other agents and custom software systems. Works with Kode CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and any agent supporting the Agent Skills Spec.
author: shareAI-lab

sections.overview:
shareAI Skills are modular knowledge packages designed to extend AI agent capabilities by providing domain expertise on-demand. They follow the Agent Skills Spec and work with Kode CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and other compatible agents. Each skill is a structured collection of expert knowledge—not code—that enables agents to understand domain-specific patterns, mindsets, and procedures. The repository includes ready-to-use skills like skill-judge for evaluating skill quality, media-writer for content adaptation, agent-builder for designing AI agents, and vibe-coding for minimal-spec development. Skills are grounded in the principle that effective knowledge packages should contain expert-only information that complements what models already know.
Extend Claude Code and Cursor with domain-specific expertise for specialized tasks
Build and evaluate custom AI agents using the agent-builder and skill-judge skills
Adapt content across multiple platforms (WeChat, Reddit, Medium, LinkedIn, Twitter) with media-writer
Create vibe-driven development workflows with minimal specifications
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/shareAI-lab/shareAI-skills`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
